contentHtml:
Paralysis is the after effect of a stroke.  High blood pressure  and High cholesterol may cause stroke.  This could be one of the most terrible conditions that a human body can be afflicted with. It is one of those diseases which needs immediate treatment and high care. The body is said to be in paralyzed stage when there is complete loss of muscle function for one or more group. This is mainly caused because of the damage caused to the nervous system. Minor stroke or  paralysis can be cured easily, but the major ones takes more time to be cured. Stroke or Paralysis may affect a human body fully or partially. Partial paralysis will affect a part of the body and complete paralysis make the whole body in paralyzed state. Paraplegia is the term used when paralysis affect the lower part of the body whereas Quadriplegia is the term used for paralysis of arms and legs. Paralysis mainly occurs due to strokes or injuries. If a Paralyzed person is getting proper treatment, he/she can have a normal life normally within a short time, all depends on the condition of the person, age and the treatment he is getting. Many take years or months to recover. Ayurveda offers the best remedy for paralysis.

The patient must come for a 3 to 6 weeks treatment. Sometimes it may take more time. All depends up on how fast the patient is recovering, it depends on the severity of the problem, how long the patient is suffering from, the age of the patient and other health problems he is having at the moment.

About our Paralysis treatment

Normally we admit the patient for a period of 3 to 6 weeks, sometimes it may take some more time. Even fully paralyzed patients coming in wheel chair can return to home by walking independently.   In a week time they get some mobility and flexibility.  Their condition will improve daily and normally within 3 to 6 weeks time they will get full mobility and flexibility, rare cases it may take more time. Our treatment is divided in to two parts, panchakarma (detoxification) therapy  techniques along with internal and external medicines.   We are using our own special medicines, and treatment techniques, which generations have passed over. We are treating Paralysis for generations and gained better knowledge and experience, which enable us to give best treatment for those suffering from stroke. You can go to our testimonials page, there you can see the patients experience with their names and address, (photo if available) some of them may be known to you, or you may have some close friends near to them. You can enquire personally.

Medicine

We are using pure Ayurvedic medicines for the treatment of Paralysis. Normally Ayurvedic medicines do not have any side effects, at the same time giving additional side benefits to you. We have our own special medicines, and prepares medicines according to the conditions and requirements of the patients. Medicines vary with condition of the patient. We have our own Medicine Manufacturing unit, having GMP Certificate. We use quality materials for the manufacture of these quality medicines.

Benefits of our treatment

  1. Normally patients will regain sensation power  and feel much better in one or two weeks.
  2. Our treatments and medicines strengthens the neuromuscular function.
  3. Gradually improves the flexibility  and mobility .
  4. Pain and related problems comes down gradually.
  5. It helps to prevent / avoid further stroke, etc…
  6. We have effective treatment for  cholesterol and Blood pressure, this helps in removing the causes from its root itself.
  7. In our treatment there is no painful exercise.
  8. It is highly cost effective.
  9. You can have a normal life and able to enjoy the life without any restrictions.
  10. You will be able to save your precious time and money; otherwise you have to spend for the treatment.
  11. Out treatments and medicines are free from side effects and helps in removing the side effects of medicines that you have taken earlier.

Duration of the treatment

Normally the patient have to undergo the therapy for 3 to 6 weeks, and continue the medications for at least one year. Rare cases the duration may increase.
